notes: Resource evaluation is distinct from imported asset provenance. Null denotes unknown or not applicable, as explained by each record. Dataset-specific licenses take precedence over general website descriptions.

resources.title: Digimouse: 3D Mouse Atlas
resources.origin: USC Biomedical Imaging Group and UCLA Crump Institute for Molecular Imaging
resources.coverage: Whole-body segmented reference; actual separate structures are determined by imported tetrahedral labels.
resources.methodology: Coregistered postmortem CT, PET and cryosection imaging; semi-automated anatomical segmentation; tetrahedral mesh.
limitations: Single postmortem male nude specimen
No female or developmental comparison
Source overview may be more detailed than distributed tetrahedral labels
No physiological validation implied
Native anatomical axis directions need explicit verification before anatomical direction labels or quantitative registration

resources.title: 3D mouse embryo model: EMA147, Stage TS23, Age E15.0 (est)
resources.origin: University of Edinburgh, eMouseAtlas; Caltech Atlas
resources.coverage: Mouse embryonic reference with anatomical segmentation; detailed structure list not yet inspected.
resources.methodology: MRI-derived reference, segmentation and STL surfaces, with NIfTI and Woolz volumes.
limitations: Embryonic anatomy is not an adult reference
Exact segmentation list, coordinate conventions and voxel spacing need file inspection
No direct registration to Digimouse established

resources.title: Mouse Genome Informatics data, annotations, MA and EMAPA ontologies

publication.title: Mouse Genome Informatics: an integrated knowledgebase system for the laboratory mouse

resources.coverage: Curated mouse genetic, expression, phenotype and anatomy annotations; MA adult anatomy and EMAPA developmental anatomy ontologies.
resources.methodology: Literature and database curation; ontology development.
limitations: Not a geometric mesh dataset
Images can have restrictive third-party copyright
Crosswalks from source segmentation labels require individual review
A specific release and citation must be selected before bulk reuse

resources.title: Allen Mouse Brain Common Coordinate Framework: Allen-CCF-2020 package

license.scope: Allen-CCF-2020 package identified in the source description; not a CC-BY-4.0 grant and not a blanket determination for separate archive releases

resources.methodology: Average reference from serial two-photon tomography; 3D anatomical annotation.

resolution.note: Other CCF archive releases provide additional resolutions; they are not assumed to be the same package.

limitations: Not whole-body anatomy
10 micrometre template spacing includes interpolation from 100 micrometre z-sampling
Selected dataset explicitly uses Allen Institute Terms of Use rather than an unrestricted CC-BY-4.0 license
Registration to Digimouse is not established
Full volume package exceeds the current 5 MB acquisition bound and has not been downloaded
Distinct Allen datasets and software can have different licenses

resources.title: A preclinical micro-computed tomography database including 3D whole body organ segmentations
resources.origin: Institute for Experimental Molecular Imaging, University Hospital Aachen and collaborators
resources.coverage: 225 native and contrast-enhanced whole-body mouse CT scans with organ segmentations; longitudinal observations.
resources.methodology: Native and contrast-enhanced in vivo micro-CT with manual or semi-automatic organ segmentation.

resolution.note: The publication also reports 0.28 mm in acquisition paragraphs; actual selected files must resolve the discrepancy.

limitations: Collection size not measured
Per-file license not established by article license
Segmentation quality varies by organ and contrast protocol
Female nude and tumor-bearing populations must not be treated as generic normal anatomy
Longitudinal scans are not independent biological replicates

resources.title: Computer model of action potential of mouse ventricular myocytes
resources.origin: Physiome Model Repository; model of Bondarenko, Szigeti, Bett, Kim and Rasmusson
resources.coverage: Mouse ventricular cell electrophysiology; no whole-body geometry.
resources.methodology: CellML mathematical model of ventricular action potential and component currents.
limitations: Not a whole-heart mechanical contraction model
Repository availability is not evidence that this application has reproduced results
Equations, parameters, numerical solver, units and independent validation must be reviewed before implementation
No prediction of treatment or disease response is supported by this resource review alone

resources.title: Selected Allen CCF 2017 regional brain OBJ candidates

publication.relationship: reference-framework methods; selected individual files remain uninspected

license.note: No separate unrestricted license for these selected 2017 OBJ files was established; do not transfer licenses from other Allen packages or access software.

resources.coverage: Individual regional brain surfaces with Allen structure identifiers; no whole-body registration.
resources.methodology: Official Allen archive surfaces corresponding to the CCF reference; geometry generation and units require file inspection.
limitations: Individual file sizes and checksums have not been preflighted
Parent and child regional surfaces may overlap
Allen IDs are not Digimouse labels or reviewed MA mappings
A source-specific frame and accepted registration are required before any whole-body overlay
No added geometry or implemented coverage is implied

resources.title: MouseLight Neuron AA1624
resources.origin: HHMI Janelia Research Campus MouseLight Project

publication.relationship: MouseLight project methods, not independent validation of this later deposit

license.verificationLimit: Primary record indexed by search; direct page and API file metadata were unavailable during this review. Verify the individual file and record version before acquisition.

resources.coverage: One reconstructed neuron; not a regional organ mesh, complete cellular atlas or observed synaptic-connectivity graph.
resources.methodology: MouseLight single-neuron reconstruction from light microscopy of sparsely labelled brains; project sources describe Allen-reference registration.
limitations: Exact file list, version, byte count, checksum and coordinates remain unverified
The cited project registration does not establish a Digimouse transform or a particular CCF release for this cell
A single morphology does not establish complete neuronal coverage or functional connectivity

resources.title: A Whole-Body Musculoskeletal Model of the Mouse: resource candidate

license.note: The article's CC-BY-4.0 license does not by itself establish a license for separate repository meshes or third-party source geometry.

resources.coverage: Published generic skeletal and limb-muscle model; actual available mesh inventory has not been inspected.
resources.methodology: Multi-source anatomical references and digitized skeletal objects with modelled limb muscle paths and Hill-type dynamics.
limitations: Repository asset license, pinned release, complete file inventory and selective sizes were not established
Composite generic model is not measured geometry of the Digimouse specimen
Muscle paths and modelling assumptions do not supply complete muscle surface anatomy
No downloaded asset or implemented model is implied

resources.title: Mouse paired bony labyrinths: MorphoMuseuM M3#1376
resources.origin: Sabrina Renaud, Léa Amar, Caroline Romestaing, Jean-Pierre Quéré and Renaud Lebrun

license.scope: The repository explicitly licenses all displayed 3D data under CC BY-NC 4.0.

resources.coverage: Two bony labyrinth surfaces from a Swiss laboratory mouse; not a complete skull or skeleton.
limitations: Exact file size, format, checksum, source-file version, acquisition method and resolution were not established
No source geometry was downloaded or incorporated
Different specimen and unknown frame preclude assumed anatomical overlay
Noncommercial terms do not provide an unrestricted commercial redistribution grant
